about_the_game:
Don the iconic digitized DJ Helmet to light up your enemies faces before smashing them unconscious with the Idols Twinkle Bat, all to the sound of broken glass, before speeding off on your stolen neon-illuminated Sandstorm Scrambler bike.

The Idols Anarchy Pack includes the following items:

• Idols DJ Helmet
• Idols Twinkle Bat
• Idols Sandstorm Scrambler

content_descriptors.notes: Saints Row contatins frequent violence with blood effects and portrays the rise of a criminal gang in a realistic modern day America. Frequent cursing, crude humor and sexual innuendos are present throughout the dialogue. The character editor allows the player to be naked including censored genitalia and uncovered breasts.
